close_reason: Added TasksBackend::enforce_is_draft_atomically() -> bool default false; gated pre-fetch get_objects on !backend.enforce_is_draft_atomically(); added set_is_draft_revert_rejected_with_prefetch test; 28 tests pass; clippy clean.
description:
The current Task/set update handler (task.rs) enforces isDraft immutability by calling get_objects::<Task> before update_object whenever the patch contains isDraft: true. This costs one extra backend round-trip per such patch even when the backend already enforces the invariant and would return invalidProperties from update_object directly.

Optimization:

1. After calling update_object and receiving Err(BackendSetError::SetError(e)) where e.error_type == SetErrorType::InvalidProperties, check if e.properties contains "isDraft".
2. If so, place the error in notUpdated[id] and skip the pre-fetch entirely — the backend has already reported the violation.
3. The pre-fetch path is retained as a fallback for backends that do NOT enforce the invariant themselves (they return Forbidden or no error on isDraft patches, not InvalidProperties).

This preserves correct behavior for all backends:
- Backends that enforce atomically: no extra get_objects call (fast path)
- Backends that don't enforce: pre-fetch still fires and catches the violation at the handler layer

Document the contract in the CalendarsBackend doc comment: 'If your backend enforces isDraft immutability atomically in update_object by returning SetError { error_type: InvalidProperties, properties: ["isDraft"] }, the handler will use that result directly without a pre-fetch round-trip.'

Acceptance criteria:
- Existing isDraft immutability tests still pass (the outcome is the same either way)
- A new test seeds a backend that returns InvalidProperties("isDraft") from update_object and verifies no get_objects call is made
- cargo test -p jmap-tasks-server exits 0
- Clippy clean
title: jmap-tasks-server: isDraft fast-path — skip get_objects pre-fetch when backend enforces
